title: Help us grow
intro: A screenshot, a photo, or a few words — anything you share helps us make The Olive Lot better for the grove. Thank you for taking the time.
commentLabel: What would you like us to know?
commentPlaceholder: What felt unclear, what you wished for, or what went well…
screenshotHint: We’ll take a picture of what you see now — useful when something looks off.
photoHint: From your camera roll or files.
needSomething: Add a comment, a screenshot, or a photo — even a short note helps.
captureFailed: We couldn’t capture the screen. You can still add a photo or write a note.
sendFailed: We couldn’t send this just now. Please try again in a moment.
thanksBody: Your note is with us. People who take a minute to share what they see are the reason The Olive Lot gets better. We’re grateful you joined in.
